brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to obtain information on efficacy and safety of SHR3824 with metformin over 24 weeks and 52 weeks in metformin monotherapy poorly glycemic controlled chinese Type 2 Diabetes. Efficacy and safety will be evaluated by comparing the effect of SHR3824 with metformin to placebo with metformin when given in oral doses.
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of SHR3824 in Combination With Metformin in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of SHR3824 Combined With Metformin in Metformin Monotherapy Poorly Glycemic Controlled Chinese Type 2 Diabetic Patients

primary_outcomes.measure: Adjusted Mean Change in HbA1c Levels

sites.facility: Third Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat - sen University
